sihoo-m18-ergonomic-office-chair.html:
What to compare before choosing the M18

The M18 is a cushioned-seat alternative to the mesh-seat C300. Shortlist it if that construction matches your preference, then compare usable seat measurements, arm spacing and seller terms. Furniblog has not hands-on tested it or established a durability advantage over another chair.

What does the M18's 2D armrest label establish?

The referenced listing uses 2D, while the SIHOO US page explicitly describes height adjustment. The label alone does not establish width, pivot or forward/back adjustment during use. Request the selected model's control diagram if one of those movements matters to your setup.

Keep regional recline specifications separate

The US page advertises 126 degrees; the wholesale page describes tilt positions reaching 130 degrees. We do not resolve that difference by assigning a universal maximum. Confirm the selected version and distinguish maximum recline from lock positions.

Fit and ownership checks

A published weight capacity is not a comfort recommendation. Ask for floor-to-seat height and usable seat depth rather than substituting overall chair dimensions. Check assembled-chair returns, freight costs and warranty eligibility before ordering.

ticova-ergonomic-office-chair.html:
When to shortlist Ticova

Consider Ticova if arm angle and forward/back movement would solve a limitation at your desk. These movements are described in the referenced listing. The linked M18 comparison separates documented movements from adjustment labels rather than treating a longer feature list as a comfort ranking.

Fit remains a model-specific question

We have not established a universal user-height recommendation, usable seat depth or a seat-depth slider for the linked configuration. Request those measurements and controls from the seller. Compare them with a chair that works at your desk before making a purchase decision.

What this research does not establish

Furniblog has not hands-on tested this chair or measured a representative failure rate. Earlier statements about a typical one-to-two-year failure pattern and a preferred height range were not supported well enough to retain. That does not establish either good or poor durability.

Check the terms attached to your order

Ticova.net's support page states a one-year warranty. Treat that as a website statement, not proof that every marketplace seller or region is covered. Confirm the provider, eligible parts, assembled returns and any freight charges with your seller.
